fire: The teacher stood at the front of the room with her arms folded across her chest.
Sit upright on the mat, cross your arms over your shoulders and twist slowly to the left.
My grandfather listened to the salesman, arms crossed, saying nothing at all.
The two old friends strolled arm in arm through the market on Sunday morning.
The bouncer leaned on the wall and folded his arms as the queue grew longer.
Lying flat, the patient was told to cross both arms over the chest during the scan.
She sat on the steps with her arms crossed tightly, refusing to come inside.
When the judge read the verdict, the coach just folded his arms and shook his head.
quiet: The teacher stood at the front of the room with her arms raised to quiet the class.
Sit upright on the mat, stretch your arms out to the sides and twist slowly to the left.

The two old friends strolled through the market on Sunday morning, chatting about football.
The bouncer leaned on the wall and checked his phone as the queue grew longer.
Lying flat, the patient was told to keep still and breathe slowly during the scan.
The rebels bought arms and ammunition from smugglers across the border.
The old armchair has carved wooden arms and a faded velvet seat.
